message: Research 8+ hands-off product channels, rank by EV to A0 by Dec 21, build top pick to ready-to-list

Repo/toolchain survey: no Rust (coordinator vetoed install - needs parent OK); VS2022+MSVC x64 present; Node26/Py3.13/requests available; cadence+4 other Toom68 repos have no licence file but Thomas owns copyright so paid builds are allowed
Apify OSM-lead niche rejected as top pick: direct competitors have 1-6 monthly users (apifystats data); payout would land Dec 21-25 at best

Top pick: chiptune sample pack on itch.io (+Bandcamp mirror) - instant PayPal payout, real browse traffic, fully agent-buildable with stdlib Python; pick 2: cadence paid build pending Rust toolchain approval
Wrote products/research.md (14 channels evaluated with evidence) and products/plan.md (pick1: chiptune pack on itch+Bandcamp; pick2: cadence build runbook for parent)
